{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace/tree_snapshot.txt
awk -F/ 'NF{if($NF=="workspace") print $0}' temp_workspace/tree_snapshot.txt > temp_workspace/candidate_entries.txt
:> temp_workspace/entry_types.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -L "$p" ]; then
    t=$(stat -c '%F' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
  elif [ -e "$p" ]; then
    t=$(stat -c '%F' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
  else
    t="missing"
  fi
  printf '%s -> %s\n' "$p" "$t" >> temp_workspace/entry_types.txt
done < temp_workspace/candidate_entries.txt

awk -F' -> ' '$2=="regular file"{print $1 " -> " $2}' temp_workspace/entry_types.txt > temp_workspace/regular_entries.txt
awk -F' -> ' '{print $1}' temp_workspace/regular_entries.txt | sort -u > temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.txt
:> temp_workspace/inaccessible.txt
:> temp_workspace/cleanup.log

if [ -s temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    case "$p" in
      /working|/working/*) ;;
      *) echo "$p" >> temp_workspace/inaccessible.txt; echo "Warning: $p not under /working" >> temp_workspace/cleanup.log; continue;;
    esac
    if [ ! -f "$p" ] || [ ! -r "$p" ]; then
      echo "$p" >> temp_workspace/inaccessible.txt
      echo "Removed inaccessible: $p" >> temp_workspace/cleanup.log
    fi
  done < temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.txt
  if [ -s temp_workspace/inaccessible.txt ]; then
    grep -F -v -x -f temp_workspace/inaccessible.txt temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.txt > temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.tmp || true
    mv temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.tmp temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.txt || true
  fi
fi

if [ -s temp_workspace/unique_workspace_files.txt ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
